services.name: Acne & Scar Treatment
services.tagline: Treating the cause, not just the breakout
services.overview: A structured approach to active acne and existing scarring, starting with identifying what's driving the breakouts — hormonal, bacterial, or lifestyle-related — before building a treatment plan.

In-clinic procedures for scarring, where suitable
Follow-up review to adjust the plan
benefits: Treatment plan matched to the actual cause
Options for both active acne and old scarring
services.recovery: Most in-clinic procedures involve mild redness for a day or two; oral or topical treatment plans have no downtime.

faqs.question: How long before I see results?
faqs.answer: Most patients see visible improvement in active acne within 4–6 weeks; scar treatment typically takes longer and is discussed at consultation.

faqs.question: Will the scarring fully go away?
faqs.answer: Results vary by scar type and depth — we'll give you a realistic expectation during your assessment rather than overpromise.

services.name: Skin Allergy & Rash Treatment
services.tagline: Proper diagnosis for itching, rashes, and reactions
services.overview: Skin allergies and rashes can come from dozens of different causes. We assess your history and symptoms to identify triggers, rather than just prescribing a generic steroid cream.

procedure: Targeted medication and, where needed, patch testing referral
Guidance on avoiding triggers going forward
benefits: Focus on identifying the actual trigger
Relief for both acute and chronic cases
services.recovery: No downtime — most patients notice symptom relief within a few days of starting treatment.

faqs.question: Do I need a referral for patch testing?
faqs.answer: No — if patch testing looks necessary, we'll arrange it directly through our network.

services.name: Hair Loss Treatment
services.tagline: Medical evaluation before any hair loss plan
services.overview: Hair loss has many possible causes — hormonal, nutritional, hereditary, or stress-related. We evaluate before recommending any treatment plan, medical or topical.
symptoms: Thinning at the crown or hairline
procedure: Personalized treatment plan (medication, topical, or procedural)
benefits: Plan based on your actual cause of hair loss

Ongoing monitoring, not a one-time fix

faqs.question: How soon will I see regrowth?
faqs.answer: Hair growth cycles are slow — most patients need 3–6 months of consistent treatment before seeing meaningful change.

services.tagline: Refresh skin texture and tone with a guided peel program
services.overview: Medical-grade chemical peels to address dullness, uneven tone, and fine texture concerns, chosen and applied based on your skin type.

blogPosts.title: 5 Common Skin Concerns a Dermatologist Can Actually Help With
blogPosts.excerpt: From stubborn acne to unexplained rashes — here's when it's worth seeing a dermatologist instead of self-treating.
blogPosts.author: Dr. Priyanka Raman
content: It's easy to try to solve skin issues with whatever product is trending, but a lot of common concerns respond much better to an actual diagnosis first.
Persistent acne that doesn't improve with over-the-counter products often has a hormonal or bacterial component that needs targeted treatment, not just a stronger cleanser.
Unexplained rashes or itching are frequently allergic reactions to something specific — a product, fabric, or even food — and identifying the trigger matters more than treating the symptom.
Hair thinning is often written off as stress, but it can also be nutritional, hereditary, or hormonal, and each cause needs a different treatment approach.
Dull or uneven skin tone can sometimes be more than cosmetic — sun damage and certain skin conditions present this way too, so it's worth a proper look.
If something on your skin has lasted more than a few weeks or keeps coming back, it's usually worth a consultation rather than more self-treatment.
